ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.Nickname: SET_ITS18 Outbreak - Nereid Deep R2 Enclosed Base
ObjectStates.Description:
Nereid Deep R2 — two connected pressure decks.
Fully enclosed underwater base: 56 open pressure hatches, looping corridors, two stairs, lower laboratories/life support and upper command/crew/medical rooms.
Use Upper Deck LIFT/STACK for access. Interior Outbreak civilian placement requires the enclosed-variant agreement in Mission > Placement.
Clear Table, then place the bag on the normal Infinity stage.

ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Model
ContainedObjects.Description:
Nereid Deep R2 | enclosed underwater habitat.
Lower deck surface 1.25 in; upper deck surface 5.25 in.
Open pressure hatches are 3.20 inches wide. Solid outer observation glazing blocks LoF.
Use Map Controls to lift the upper deck for lower-floor access.
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
function onLoad() self.setLock(true);Grid.show_lines=false;Grid.snapping=1 end
function onDestroy()
 local key='loboClearing:100e3e'
 if Global.getVar(key) then return end
 Global.setVar(key,true)
 local doomed={}
 for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
  if o~=self and o.hasTag('LoboMap:100e3e') then doomed[#doomed+1]=o end
 end
 for _,o in ipairs(doomed) do o.destruct() end
 Global.setVar(key,false)
end

local function loboLifeAlive()
 if loboLifeDead or self.isDestroyed() then return false end
 if loboLifeAnchor then
  local anchor=getObjectFromGUID(loboLifeAnchor)
  if loboLifeWasPlaced and (not anchor or anchor.isDestroyed()) then return false end
  local p=self.getPosition()
  if anchor and math.abs(p.x)<=44 and math.abs(p.z)<=26 and math.abs(p.y)<=26 then loboLifeWasPlaced=true end
 end
 return true
end
local function loboLifeGetBroker()
 if loboLifeBroker and not loboLifeBroker.isDestroyed() then return loboLifeBroker end
 local guid=Global.getVar('LoboMapUIBrokerV4')
 local broker=guid and getObjectFromGUID(guid) or nil
 if not broker then
  for _,candidate in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag('LoboMapUIBrokerV4') or {}) do broker=candidate;break end
 end
 if not broker then
  broker=spawnObjectData({data=JSON.decode(loboLifeBrokerData)})
  if broker then Global.setVar('LoboMapUIBrokerV4',broker.getGUID()) end
 end
 loboLifeBroker=broker;return broker
end
local function loboLifeCall(name,p)
 local broker=loboLifeBroker
 if not broker or broker.isDestroyed() or not loboLifeToken then return nil end
 p=p or {};p.owner=loboLifeOwner;p.token=loboLifeToken
 return broker.call(name,p)
end

-- The lift is a viewing aid. All geometry and figures retain local positions.
local nereidDeckLifted=false
local nereidDeckBusy=false
local nereidPendingLocks={}
local nereidLastAnchor=nil
local nereidLiftDx=58
local function nereidAnchor()
 local m=getObjectFromGUID('100e95')
 if m then
  local p=m.getPosition();nereidLastAnchor={x=p.x,y=p.y,z=p.z}
 end
 return nereidLastAnchor
end
local function nereidUpperObjects()
 local out={}
 for _,o in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag('NereidDeck2')or{})do
  if o.hasTag('LoboMap:100e3e')then out[#out+1]=o end
 end
 return out
end
local function nereidTransfer(lift,clearing)
 if nereidDeckBusy and not clearing then return end
 if not clearing and not loboLifeAlive()then return end
 if Global.getVar('hld')==1 and not clearing then
  Wait.time(function()if loboLifeAlive()then nereidTransfer(lift,false)end end,.2);return
 end
 local a=nereidAnchor();if not a then return end
 local upper=nereidUpperObjects()
 if #upper>0 then nereidDeckLifted=upper[1].getPosition().x-a.x>29 end
 if lift==nereidDeckLifted then return end
 local origin=a.x+(nereidDeckLifted and nereidLiftDx or 0)
 local dx=lift and nereidLiftDx or -nereidLiftDx
 local carried={}
 -- Bounds bottoms identify resting miniatures despite different model pivots.
 for _,o in ipairs(getAllObjects())do
  if o~=self and (not o.hasTag('LoboMap:100e3e')or o.hasTag('NereidMovableMission'))and o.getBounds then
   local b=o.getBounds();local p=o.getPosition()
   if b and b.center and b.size then
    local bottom=b.center.y-b.size.y/2
    if math.abs(b.center.x-origin)<23.8 and math.abs(b.center.z-a.z)<23.8 and bottom>=a.y+3.86 and bottom<a.y+8.6 then
     local g=o.getGUID();local locked=o.getLock()
     if nereidPendingLocks[g]~=nil then locked=nereidPendingLocks[g]end
     carried[#carried+1]={object=o,guid=g,locked=locked,position={p.x+dx,p.y,p.z}}
    end
   end
  end
 end
 nereidDeckBusy=true
 for _,r in ipairs(carried)do nereidPendingLocks[r.guid]=r.locked;r.object.setLock(true)end
 for _,o in ipairs(upper)do local p=o.getPosition();o.setPosition({p.x+dx,p.y,p.z});o.setLock(true)end
 for _,r in ipairs(carried)do
  local o=r.object;o.setPosition(r.position)
  if o.setVelocity then o.setVelocity({0,0,0})end
  if o.setAngularVelocity then o.setAngularVelocity({0,0,0})end
 end
 nereidDeckLifted=lift
 -- Always restore the original locks, including when Clear Table intervenes.
 local function restoreLocks()
  for _,r in ipairs(carried)do
   local o=getObjectFromGUID(r.guid)
   if o then o.setLock(r.locked)end
   nereidPendingLocks[r.guid]=nil
  end
  nereidDeckBusy=false
 end
 if clearing then restoreLocks()else Wait.frames(restoreLocks,3)end
end

local nereidLiftDestroy=onDestroy
function onDestroy()

 end

end
